apply_order_rationale_2026_09_03: ThermoWorks stays first, on evidence rather than habit. Instant-read thermometer is our #1 gear category (21 cut pages, 4 recipes) and leave-in probe is #2 (16 cut pages, 4 recipes), so the two categories where ThermoWorks is the reference brand are also the two we surface most. Their Thermapen ONE IS on Amazon but ranks 26th on the head query with 1,300 reviews, so our Amazon pipeline structurally under-serves them: they are direct-to-consumer, which is exactly why the direct program is the right route. Economics: 10% of a $74-$311 ThermoWorks basket is $7 to $31 per conversion against roughly $0.68 for Amazon's 4.5% on a $15 instant-read. About 11x. AFTER ThermoWorks, prefer the brands we already link (RTIC, Weber, Lodge) over more brands we do not, because those convert traffic that already exists.
